title: A look at effective altruism's fall after SBF's arrest and how the soon-to-be rich from upcoming AI IPOs give the movement a chance to return larger than ever (Andrew Fedorov/New York Magazine)
summary: Andrew Fedorov / New York Magazine: A look at effective altruism's fall after SBF's arrest and how the soon-to-be rich from upcoming AI IPOs give the movement a chance to return larger than ever — Out of the spotlight, the movement has been preparing for the soon-to-be AI rich to donate billions.
